liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (1 review): The Help>Slipknot>Franklin's sequence is very well played, per this reviewer [10]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Long Franklin's Tower after a tight Help>Slip, with Vince's piano making it shine [17]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Rooster was played in classic Chicago blues style [17]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Reviewer says it has minor flubs but should have been on the So Many Roads box set instead of a rehearsal [19]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls The Other One among the best they've heard, with the band on fire [13]
- **Liberty** (1 review): Jerry is still smiling during a strong Liberty [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-11.mtx.seamons.120865.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd93-03-11.sbd.wharfrat.10383.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 3.13/5 by 15 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard isn't crisp, though still worth hearing; Reviewer says it sounds so good it could pass for the best audience recording from the Rosemont; Reviewer finds the soundboard output thin and flimsy, though definitely a soundboard [9][10][14]
- **gd93-03-11.aud.gardner.10538.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has fair sound with too much treble, but captures the crowd's feel well [11]
- **gd1993-03-11.sennME80.wklitz.96384.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this audience tape is far better in quality than the mixing-desk recording [18]

## Around the show

- Crowd atmosphere is prominent on the tape; one audience member can be heard starting to react [11]
- Pre-show lot scene outside Rosemont was chaotic, with too many fans for security to handle [17]
- Reviewer points to the 12 February 1992 show as a companion; Jerry seems jollier here about his day job [12]
- Reviewer says few great shows happened at Rosemont and suggests trying other shows first [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-11.mtx.seamons.120865.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Jubal H. Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) [1]. Also: Master DAT (Sony R500) to Tascam SS-R05, then Samplitude, to FLAC; transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller; Master audience recording made by Mr. Darby using AKG C451EB/CK1 microphones [1]
- **gd93-03-11.sbd.wharfrat.10383.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>CAS>DAT>CD [3]
- **gd93-03-11.aud.gardner.10538.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tony G; source: Audience: AKG 460's [4]
- **gd1993-03-11.sennME80.wklitz.96384.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 [7]. Also: Sennheiser microphone rig audience tape by Leitzenberger; reviewer got a copy of this lineage in April 1993 [18]
